channel.title: Mobikom | Insights, Technical Manifestos & Network News
channel.description: Official RSS dispatch feed for mobikom.bg - Web performance manifestos, hardware guides, media publishing chronologies, network advertising solutions, and Bulgarian telecommunications archives.

item.title: Computer Memory for Non-Specialists
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA)
item.description: A practical engineering guide by Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA explaining DDR RAM generations, dual-channel bus widening, CPU cache proximity laws (L1-L3), rotational hard drives (HDD), multi-disk RAID configurations, and flash storage endurance.

item.title: About the Website Requirements & Designing (The 512-Byte Manifesto)
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA)
item.description: Less is more, simple is more secure. An architectural deep dive on eliminating runtime dependencies, third-party scripts, and databases in favor of pure HTML5 and CSS Grid Level 2 for sub-10ms delivery and native privacy.

item.title: Dobruja Media Group Heritage & Foundation Chronology
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA)
item.description: The evolutionary timeline of North-East Bulgaria's independent online publishing network: tracing the 2011 launches of sport.dobruja.com and news.dobruja.com to the establishment of dobrichnews.com and bestjobs.bg integration.

item.title: Advertising on Our Media Network Without Tracking Telemetry
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA)
item.description: Explore direct sponsorships, high-impact static display placements, and verified regional reach across dobrichnews.com, dobruja.com, and bestjobs.bg with instantaneous edge delivery and zero third-party cookie consent bloat.

item.title: The NMT-450 Mobifon & Paging Revolution in Bulgaria
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA)
item.description: An engineering review of Bulgaria's first commercial wireless cellular network launched by RTC Mobikom in 1992: analog 450 MHz propagation, rugged Benefon/Nokia handsets, and nationwide paging and Mobika phonecard systems.

item.title: Sea Stars: Pomorie Lye & Natural Mineral Wellness
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Stoyan Stoyanov, MBA)
item.description: Preserving the digital catalog and product science of authentic Black Sea mineral salts and therapeutic Pomorie lake lye (луга) formulated by the Bulgarian Academy of Sciences (BAS).

item.title: Verified Zero-Leak Privacy Audit & Architecture Standard
item.author: office@mobikom.bg (Mobikom Compliance Desk)
item.description: Official publication of the mobikom.bg zero-tracking security standard: zero cookies, zero localStorage, referrer protection enforcement, and Cloudflare edge IP anonymization.
